gold: Drug-induced dermatomyositis secondary to ipilimumab therapy

selector.why: The presence of specific skin findings such as photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption, flat-topped pink to erythematous papules over knuckles, and prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles, along with muscle weakness, decided the diagnosis.

support_spans: Grade 4/5 strength on resisted abduction of shoulders bilaterally
Reduced activity level due to weakness and early fatigue
Mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
contradict_spans: Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis
